anokāsa.cp: adj. having no opportunity, space or time.
anokāsa.p: [Na+okāsa] (pu) CL=9 There are two types of Samāsa for this word: Yuttattha Samāsa and Ayuttatta Samāsa. Translation cannot be made with this word alone, this word is translated together with another word. Tañcesuddhadiṭṭhi samāno anokāsaṃ kārāpetvā cāvanādhippāyo vadeti. Vi,1.253. Translate 'anokāsam kārāpetvā' as 'giving no permission'. See Mog.3,12, its Pañcikā and Nissaya. See also Anokāsakamma, Anodhi, Apaccakkha. (1) not period-time-place-opportunity; placed which is improper- unallowed- prohibited. (a) insufficient place. (b) improper place; place of genitals. (2) improper time- opportunity. See also Akāla (d). (Ti) (3) having no time- chance; he. (4) having no place to exit. (5) the Sikkhāpada which have Padasodhammasamuṭṭhāna 'Anokāsakataṃ bhikkhuṃ pañhaṃ puccheyya'. See also Anavakāsa.
